name: llama-vulkan-spark
description: Upstream ggml-org official Vulkan build, multi-arch manifest. Mirrored on arm64 host (spark2) so docker pull selects the linux/arm64 variant. Runs on NVIDIA GB10 via the libnvidia-egl-vulkan driver bind-mounted by /usr/local/bin/hb-llama. Upstream is daily-rolling (cron 04:12 UTC).
